scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend pytest backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
